title: World Languages
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for the current English CLDR base-language manifest. Each record represents one published base-language identifier and its English CLDR display name.
methodology: SoftData compiled the current English CLDR base-language manifest from Unicode CLDR JSON release 48.2.0. The approved source files were verified by hash, the published alias set was normalized before publication, and only base-language identifiers were retained. The approved remaps were fat -> ak, sh -> sr-Latn -> sr, tl -> fil and tw -> ak. Regional locale variants, script-qualified identifiers, private-use identifiers and alias-only identifiers were excluded from the v1 public manifest. The resulting dataset contains 633 unique identifiers and 633 unique names, sorted bytewise by id.
update_policy: Review against a deliberately selected CLDR release; do not silently upgrade the pinned source release.
known_limitations: The catalog is a CLDR-derived base-language manifest, not a census of all languages spoken in any country or area.
